findings.classification: Actual Cave Story reconstruction; proprietary original logic with MIT only for authored modifications
findings.decision: Existing exclusion reconfirmed at unchanged pin; content replacements cannot cure inherited code gate. Bundled SDL Emscripten files and Null audio option do not establish a playable Web build.

findings.classification: Actual Sonic Gems Collection-derived reconstruction with native per-level launcher
findings.decision: Root CC0 declaration retained but inherited original code/tables and full independent content unclosed. Exact SDL2 zlib and vgmstream ISC notices read separately; parent disables listed external codecs including FFmpeg rather than automatically enabling them. Browser scheduler/mute/content still unverified.

findings.classification: WIP GameCube matching-target reconstruction, not native browser port
findings.decision: No overall game/SDK/runtime grant identified in pinned tree; original DOL/REL and original-era compiler path required. SOURCES.md provenance credits are not grants. No source-completeness percentage inferred.

findings.classification: Partial Windows-compatible DLL/data reconstruction of same SADX title
findings.decision: README expressly prohibits commercial use and claims no original code ownership; starts with original model/animation DLL data. Not a full permissively licensed reconstructed browser game.

findings.classification: Cave Story engine reimplementation in Rust, not matching decompilation
findings.decision: MIT-declared source candidate, no blanket content or dependency closure. Current upstream already MIT; old lastmit fork is not needed to obtain an MIT-declared version. Broad engine-recreation expansion remains paused. Native SDL2/glutin/CPAL stack plus full independent game content/browser work unverified.
findings.contentEvidence: builtin_fs.rs compiles font PNGs/descriptors, icon/touch/interface art, locale and original-named Organya wave tables via include_bytes!. No payloads acquired; root MIT is not per-file provenance.
findings.dependencyEvidence: Organya wave_bank.rs SPDX MIT read separately; full crate/git/runtime source notices and compiled media not cleared.

findings.classification: Older fork of same engine/game identity
findings.decision: MIT notice separately verified; duplicate lead, README describes CI freeware data, not independent content. Different default features include Lua/netplay; no current dependency equivalence or Web build inferred.

findings.classification: SH4 static recompilation framework and hardware abstraction, not a source decompilation or finished game
findings.decision: MIT explicitly applies only to framework, excludes generated commercial-game code. Native optional SDL/OpenGL/GLEW and planned GPL Flycast backend differ; proposed backend is not shipped framework code. No independent game content/browser gameplay or clean-room certificate.
